description: Mint a dfm_ API key for this agent's owner (SIWS session only). READ-ONLY: write keys and write caps are refused unless the operator set DFM_ALLOW_WRITE_KEY_MINT=1. Expires in 30 days by default (max 90). The key is written to ~/.config/dfm/api-keys/<name>-<prefix>.key (0600) and NEVER returned to the chat; only its prefix and path are. Optional last step of: create_identity_wallet → SIWS login (automatic) → set_profile {displayName} (avatar: operator image or a generated default) → create_app_wallet → app_wallet_fund {usdc, sol} → create_api_key (optional).
name: create_api_key
title: Mint a dfm_ API key
